scope: Render one bounded contiguous frame range in deterministic order, then commit the produced PNGs as ordinary Panda ImageAssets transactionally. R2 is a strict superset of the R1 single-frame product path; it does not introduce a parallel snapshot contract and it does not add a parallel renderer.

R2-C.title: Main-side sequence service (orchestrator + budget + supersede + cancel)

R2-G.title: frame sequence commit service + R2-D end-to-end stale guard
R2-G.ci: Draft CI on 4b39e97 (in flight at this writing; prior R2-C / R2-D.1 commits all PASS)

invariants.R2-B_concurrency: maxActualRasterConcurrency = 1 by design and by enforcement; serial for-await over the frame source plus the R1 rasterizer's own single-job-at-a-time invariant
invariants.R2-B_cumulative_pixels: 402,653,184 cumulative pixel cap (24 frames * 16,777,216 = 24 * 4,096^2); unreachable in the per-frame ≤16,777,216 path, retained as the belt-and-suspenders safety net for the sequence service
invariants.R2-B_cumulative_bytes: 1.5 GiB cumulative encoded-bytes cap (24 * 64 MiB); a real R1 rasterizer per-frame cap of 64 MiB makes normal 24-frame load 1.5 GiB at the wall
invariants.R2-D_latest_request_wins: starting a new sequence for the same sessionId supersedes the previous one; the previous renderSequence() promise resolves with ok:false, code:SEQUENCE_CANCELLED, completedFrameCount
invariants.R2-D_stale_sequence: R2-G commit rejects any non-latest confirmedSequenceRequestId (and any confirmed bytes that have been released, and any per-frame sha256/width/height/byteLength echo that does not match the acceptance store) with STALE_SEQUENCE before any file write
invariants.R2-E_no_renderer_png_buffer: the Renderer never accumulates the per-frame PNGs; Main owns the per-sequence byte store briefly and releases it after a successful commit or an invalidateSequenceSession
invariants.R2-G_single_revision: all N new ImageAssets commit in one Project revision + 1 via a single transaction.save; a failed batch rolls back atomically (no half-written asset file, no half-written project.json)
invariants.R2-G_dedup: per-frame sha256 dedup against current.project.assets; reused assets skip file write, new assets write via writeFlaCommitTemporary + finalizeFlaCommitTemporary (atomic hard-link)

securityBoundary.rendererReceivesPngBuffer: only via the single handoff at the R2-G commit boundary; never accumulated

outstandingR2Work.R2-H_UX: renderer-side multi-frame preview UI (range slider, preview grid, re-render / cancel / import buttons). Renderer-side work belongs in a real Windows Electron acceptance run; deferred to the V2-R2 acceptance phase. The R2-C / R2-G services are wired and tested; the UX surfaces consume the existing R2 contracts (FlaFrameSequenceRequest / FlaFrameSequenceCommitRequest) and do not require new contract changes.
